name: End Time People
overview: Scripture reveals that the end times will be marked by the global proclamation of the gospel, signaling the approaching return of Christ, though the exact day and hour remain unknown to all but the Father. Believers are urged to remain vigilant, prayerful, and ready, as the Son of Man will come unexpectedly. The spiritual battle is also highlighted, with Satan described as the deceiver of the whole world, cast down along with his angels, underscoring the reality of spiritual warfare in these last days.
